text:
Leah Park: Idea 1: run a 30m 'Lite Onboarding Sprint' for small accounts that only want a fast walkthrough + 10m troubleshooting. After-hours friendly (5:30pm PT). Who can host?
Omar Khalid: I can host one Tue/Thu. Keep it to 30m max. Suggest agenda: 10m setup walkthrough, 10m quick demo, 10m live Q&A.
Tess Wu: Can we do a short prep checklist attendees get 48h before? One-pager with required creds and sample prompt. Cuts down live time.
Ravi Patel: I'll draft the one-pager. Also propose a 2-question poll at the end: "Did this session unblock you?" and "Any blockers that need CS follow-up?"
Leah Park: Nice. We should also tag any "needs follow-up" answers to the account CSM automatically. Can someone wire that?
EnablementBot: Pro tip: use webhook flow 'enablement-to-csm' to auto-create follow-up tasks. See runbook: https://wiki.internal/enablement/runbooks#webhooks
Omar Khalid: @EnablementBot pinged infra team last week; webhook is ready. We just need the mapping from poll responses to CSM queue.
Tess Wu: I'll make the poll in Slido and set the mapping. Also will record session and upload to /enablement/lite-sprints.
Ravi Patel: Calendar note: prefer 17:30 PT for US west; that hits 00:30 CET though. Maybe offer two repeats: 17:30 PT and 08:30 GMT for EMEA morning.
Leah Park: Good call. Two repeats reduces churn. Assign hosts: Omar = west slot, Tess = EMEA slot. I'll be backup host and coordinator.
Omar Khalid: Can CalendarBot reserve org Zoom + enable recording? Need transcript turned on.
CalendarBot: Zoom link reserved: https://zoom.redwood.com/meet/1761116789. Recording + transcript enabled. Invite template: cs-lite-sprint.
Tess Wu: I'll prepare a 90s teaser vid and the one-pager Ravi is drafting. Ravi, drop the doc in the shared folder and ping me.
Ravi Patel: Dropped draft: https://drive.redwood/en/onepagers/lite-onboarding-draft. Please comment.
Leah Park: One more: capture renewal signal. At the end poll, add "Are you likely to migrate to paid Dedicated within 90 days?" (yes/considering/"no"). Flag "no" for follow-up.
EnablementBot: Workflow added: poll -> if response = no then create ticket in #csm-triage with tag "renewal-watch".
Omar Khalid: We should also collect a quick system snapshot during the session (model, seq len, qps). Add a short form for attendees to paste sample config.
Tess Wu: I'll add a tiny pastebin link during the Q&A slide and remind folks.
Ravi Patel: I'll build the short feedback form: 3 radio questions + 1 free text. Link will be in the calendar invite and post-chat.
Leah Park: ACTIONS: Ravi finish one-pager + form, Tess record teaser + host EMEA slot, Omar host US slot + confirm webhook mapping, Leah coordinate invites and dry-run.
Tess Wu: Dry-run? Can we do a 20m dry-run 48h before first event (tech check + slide timing)?
Omar Khalid: Yep. Add me. Also add a note to the invite that attendance counts as "enablement touch" in renewal MRR cadence.
EnablementBot: Reminder set: dry-run 48h before. Auto-invite CSMs: @team-csm.
Leah Park: Cool 1 I scheduled dry-run for 2024-08-05T16:00:00Z. Calendar invites will go out after Ravi finalizes materials.
CalendarBot: Invites queued. Will send when materials folder contains 'one-pager-final.pdf' and 'teaser.mp4'.
Ravi Patel: Uploaded final one-pager and form link: https://forms.redwood/lite-feedback. All set from my side.
Tess Wu: Uploaded teaser and slides to /enablement/lite-sprints. Invites sent to registrants.
Leah Park: Thanks team. Please confirm with a reaction :white_check_mark: when you re good.
Omar Khalid: :white_check_mark:
Tess Wu: :white_check_mark:
Ravi Patel: :white_check_mark:
EnablementBot: Post-session checklist will run: upload recording, export transcript, push follow-ups to CSM queue.
